method: Revised 2026-10-02: restricts each site's FLUXNET2015 and Shuttle per-flux median to ONLY the calendar years where BOTH datasets have a QC_THRESHOLD_YY=0.5-qualifying value for that flux (R/site_annual_fluxes.R::compute_site_annual_fluxes()/compute_site_annual_fluxes_from_df()), matched independently per flux (NEP/ET/H). fluxnet2015_n_sites == shuttle_n_sites by construction (same site set contributes to both axes). Isolates ONEFlux processing-version differences from network-composition/coverage differences -- see review/figures/methods_flux_medians.md, 'Processing-version confound'.
igbp_class_source: current Shuttle classification only (site_flux_medians_shuttle.csv), one label per site used for both axes
